assays.assay_description: 5-min test in a wooden EPM (two open 50x10 cm arms, two enclosed 50x10x40 cm arms, 10x10 cm central platform, 50 cm above floor). Measured % open-arm time, stretched-attend postures, and enclosed-arm entries. Conducted in naive males, naive females, and fear-conditioned males.

application_type.evidence: administered orally (per gavage) in a 2.5-ml kg-1 volume

setup_habituation.evidence: no apparatus habituation described for the EPM

setup_restrain.evidence: animals freely explored the elevated plus-maze for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: no food in the EPM apparatus during the 5-min test

water_restriction.evidence: no water in the EPM apparatus during the 5-min test

time_to_assay.evidence: given 60 min before the elevated plus-maze test

sample_size.evidence: Experiment 1: n = 13, 11, 11 and 12; Experiment 2: n = 7 and 7; Experiment 4: n = 9 and 10

outcomes.summary: Oral AYA (0.1-1.0 mg/kg DMT) did not change % open-arm time or stretched-attend postures in male or female rats, indicating no anxiogenic/anxiolytic effect. The 1.0 mg/kg dose increased enclosed-arm entries in naive males (increased general exploratory activity). Fear-conditioned males treated with 0.3 mg/kg AYA showed no EPM differences vs vehicle.
outcomes.statistics: η2 = 0.17 for enclosed-arm entries; P ≤ 0.05 versus VEH (one-way ANOVA, Newman-Keuls)
outcomes.evidence: The three AYA groups presented values similar to controls for these anxiety-related measures... The AYA (DMT 1.0) group presented significantly higher values than the VEH group [enclosed-arm entries].

assays.assay_description: Rats conditioned in Context A (3x 1 mA 3-s shocks). Extinction learning session(s) of 15 min in Context A (one or two sessions, 1 day apart), with single or repeated oral AYA (0.3 mg/kg DMT, 60 min pre-session) and/or intra-IL infusions of MDL-11,939 (5-HT2A antagonist) or WAY-100635 (5-HT1A antagonist) 10 min pre-session. Test A (3-min recall in Context A), Test B (3-min novel Context B), reinstatement (single US in Context C), and Retest A (3-min). Tested with 1- and 21-day-old memories in males and females. Outcome: % time freezing.

application_type.evidence: oral (per gavage) AYA 60 min before extinction; intra-infralimbic cortex infusions of MDL-11,939 or WAY-100635 10 min before extinction

setup_habituation.evidence: For familiarization, each animal was placed alone in a rectangular chamber... designated Context A, allowed to explore it for 3 min

setup_restrain.evidence: animals freely placed in conditioning chamber

food_restriction.evidence: no food in chamber during recording

water_restriction.evidence: no water in chamber during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: given 60 min before the extinction learning session

sample_size.evidence: Experiments 3 and 5-12 group sizes range from n=7 to n=11 per group

outcomes.summary: Single oral AYA (0.3 mg/kg DMT) enhanced within-session freezing extinction without affecting extinction recall. Repeated AYA (2 daily doses) enhanced both within-session extinction and extinction recall (lower freezing at Test A) for 1-day-old and 21-day-old memories, in both males and females. Reinstatement abolished group differences. Intra-IL MDL-11,939 (5-HT2A antagonist) at 0.3 μg impaired within-session extinction by itself; at 0.1 μg it blocked AYA's within-session effect but not its extinction-recall effect. Intra-IL WAY-100635 (5-HT1A antagonist) did not affect extinction alone but blocked AYA's between-session (recall) effect.
outcomes.statistics: Experiment 3: ηp2 = 0.33 (treatment), 0.58 (time bin); Experiment 5: ηp2 = 0.44; oral treatment x repeated testing interactions ηp2 = 0.22-0.40; mixed ANOVA, Newman-Keuls post hoc, P ≤ 0.05
outcomes.evidence: AYA-treated animals expressed relatively further reductions [in freezing]... The AYA group presented significantly lower freezing values than controls during Test A

B1_num_measures.evidence: Freezing behaviour... expressed as the percentage of total session time.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: time bin... significantly influenced the time spent in freezing... groups gradually presented lower values throughout the extinction session

B4_ethological.evidence: Freezing... defined as a total absence of body and head movements

D2_session_duration.evidence: Each animal was exposed to the conditioned context in the fear extinction learning session without US presentation for 15 min.

judge_notes: Merged all fear-conditioning experiments (Exp 3, 5-12) into a single 'Contextual Fear Conditioning and Extinction' assay per rubric: same paradigm with different drug/dose/route/sex/memory-age manipulations is ONE assay.
Kept EPM as a separate assay (Exp 1, 2, 4) since it is a different apparatus measuring anxiety/exploration.

Added MDL-11,939 and WAY-100635 as separate dosing entries since these are pharmacological compounds administered intra-IL in the behavioural experiments (route = 'other' = intra-cerebral/intra-IL infusion).
B1 for EPM scored 1 (2-3 measures) per modal qwen value; glm's score of 2 was inconsistent with its own value label.

E6 for fear conditioning scored 0: although three contexts (A/B/C) are used across sessions, each individual recording session takes place in a single chamber without multi-compartment within-session structure.
